Hakai Institute Nereocystis cover calibration fit

Source: R/fits.R
fit_cover_calibration_hakai_nereo.Rd

A fit of kelpbio::kb_fit_cover_calibration_nereo() to Hakai Institute in situ surveys in British Columbia, each paired with a drone flight, for predicting canopy biomass with kelpbio::kb_predict_biomass_canopy() without fitting a calibration. Each survey's wet biomass per m² is predicted by kelpbio::kb_predict_biomass_in_situ() from fit_weight_hakai_nereo and fit_size_hakai_nereo. Surveys with no plants counted are included. Surveys in site-years whose plants were sized only by cumulative blade length are excluded.

Usage

fit_cover_calibration_hakai_nereo

Format

An object of class c("kb_fit_cover_calibration_nereo", "kb_fit_cover_calibration", "kb_fit"). The data are in fit$data.

Attribution
